whenToUse: Site headers whose top level items open panels of links, such as docs, components or industry pages
Mega menu panels that lay out links with summaries in columns, with glyphs and a call to action button
Header rows that mix panel triggers with plain top level links styled to match them

whenNotToUse.when: Actions on the current page, such as edit, share or sign out, opened from one button
Sections of a signed in app listed down the screen edge and kept in view
A complete header with logo, link panels and a Get Started button already placed

agentNotes: `NavigationMenuLink` takes its anchor through `render` on the base twin and `asChild` on the radix twin; neither twin reads the other one's prop
Every `href` is a hash placeholder; point each `NavigationMenuLink` at a real route, through your router link where you have one
The radix `NavigationMenu` opens panels in a shared `NavigationMenuViewport` unless `viewport` is false; base has no `viewport` prop and uses `align`
